page.layout: One printed page (title page), centred. Large title block at top; author lines below; woodcut engraving in the middle (emblem with mottoes "EST VIA INVIA" and "INVIA VIRTUTI" around a figure on a mountain); publisher and date below the engraving.
page.notes: The title block has a reddish ink stain over the words "IN DVAS" and "PARTES" (partly obscuring "Duas" and "Partes"); readings there are reconstructed from context and marked as doubtful. The woodcut shows a figure climbing a mountain with a tree and an eagle; its border mottoes read "EST VIA INVIA" (left) and "INVIA VIRTUTI" (right), with "NVLLA" at the lower left. The top title line is printed "INTRODVCTIO BREVIS" with the division broken as "INTRO DV-/CTIO", so the first line reads "INTRODVCTIO". No page number, running head or signature is printed.
